lead_story: The Federal Reserve's decision to hold interest rates steady has sparked uncertainty in the market, with a divided Fed and rising geopolitical tensions in the Middle East. This has led to a sell-off in Treasury bonds and a rise in gold prices. The outcome of the Fed's decision will be closely watched by investors and may lead to further market volatility.
